passion_play_intro: "Our Children, Our Good Friday" is a Community Passion Play of Christ was started by Dr. Regi Paul in 1998. The program is designed to teach children power of peace and non-violent techniques based on Jesus Christ's "Seven Words on the Cross" and its application for peace and harmony among all the nations of world.
mission_statement: We strive to “Awaken the Child's faith in oneself by uniting the communities together with the hearts and hands of our children. We explore critical thinking skills to help our children understand the world around them by using the life choices of Christ as a teaching tool. We help prepare them to understand value of Power of Peace and to contemplate on many hard decisions encountered in life of Christ. Christ could have denied his responsibility , run or even struck out at his enemies, yet his belief in Himself and compassion for others and obedience to the will of God drove him to do what he knew was right. This is the strength and resolve we hope to awaken in child for a better world of tomorrow. We teach Children Peace not War.
program_highlights: The highlight of the program is that each year a young man is selected to play the role of “Jesus Christ” in the passion play. After the play, this person is requires to be a role model for children of our world community. In this way we hope to develop strong human families in our nation and around the world.
practice_info: The Children from age 6 thru 21 are accepted. No prior drama experience is required. Parents and community participation is the essence and the core foundation of our program. The program starts in November of each year and ends after the performance of the play during the Easter Week.
